name: Biome Format on Save
description: Automatically formats files with Biome after Claude writes or edits them, supporting JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, and CSS
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Format with Biome after file write/edit
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Only format supported file types
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|css)$ ]]; then
  if command -v npx &>/dev/null && [[ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/biome.json" || -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/biome.jsonc" ]]; then
    npx biome format --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
    echo "Formatted with Biome: $FILE"
  fi
fi
exit 0
